coloring-space-explorer.title: Astronaut Among The Planets
coloring-space-explorer.description: A smiling cartoon astronaut reaches forward while floating among planets, stars, and space rocks. A ringed planet and a distant spiral galaxy surround the spacesuit.

coloring-sweet-treats.description: Three cupcakes have swirls of frosting topped with strawberries and flowers. Sliced berries, daisies, and leaves fill the spaces between the desserts.

coloring-botanical-mandala.title: Floral Leaf Mandala
coloring-botanical-mandala.description: Layered petals radiate from a small central flower into repeating leaves, blossoms, and bead-like details. The symmetrical pattern offers many small sections for a limited or repeating palette.

coloring-woodland-owl.title: Owl Under A Crescent Moon

coloring-sleepy-kitten.title: Sleeping Kitten With Yarn

coloring-playful-puppy.description: A fluffy, floppy-eared puppy sits with its tongue out and a ball beside one paw. Tall daisies and grass frame the playful garden scene.

coloring-little-hedgehog.title: Hedgehog With Mushrooms
coloring-little-hedgehog.description: A small hedgehog stands on a leafy woodland floor beside a spotted mushroom. Its pointed spines contrast with broad leaves, flowers, and a fallen log.

coloring-hibiscus-garden.description: One large hibiscus bloom is surrounded by smaller flowers, buds, and tropical foliage. Broad petals, a detailed flower center, and split leaves create a mix of open and intricate spaces.

coloring-gentle-deer.title: Fawn In A Woodland Garden
coloring-gentle-deer.description: A spotted fawn rests beneath leafy branches beside a stream. Flowers, ferns, rocks, and distant evergreen trees surround its curled body.

coloring-friendly-dragon.title: Dragon By A Fairytale Castle
coloring-friendly-dragon.description: A young winged dragon sits on a garden path in front of a turreted castle. Large wing panels and belly sections sit alongside smaller scales, flowers, and stonework.

coloring-farm-friends.title: Calf By The Barn
coloring-farm-friends.description: A young cow stands among daisies beside a wooden fence and barn. Its outlined coat patches and broad body offer a clear starting point before the smaller farm details.
